map.：周期第 22 天：孕酮 P>5 ng/mL、E2 适中、LH 已回落→提示已排: : On cycle day 22: progesterone P>5 ng/mL, moderate E2, and LH already back down suggest ovulation has occurred (luteal phase); if P<3 and keeps not rising, that suggests anovulation. Together with FSH/E2 it gives a first read on ovarian reserve.
map.性激素六项什么时候查？: When Should the Six Sex Hormones Be Tested?
map.评估卵巢基础功能多在周期第 2–4 天（卵泡早期）；判断排卵则在黄体中期（第 2: Baseline ovarian function is usually assessed on cycle days 2–4 (early follicular); to confirm ovulation, check progesterone in the mid-luteal phase (days 21–23); follow your doctor's advice in detail.
map.卵泡早期 LH/FSH>2–3 支持 PCOS 倾向；FSH 升高伴 E2 低提: An early follicular LH/FSH above 2–3 supports a tendency toward PCOS; elevated FSH with low E2 indicates reduced ovarian reserve and must be read together with AMH and age.
